## Vendor package signal

Preserved SUNMI official-source research recorded a downloadable package named `SunmiPaySDKV2_v2.0.42_2026-06-12.zip`. This is stored as a vendor-package date signal, not as the Maven publication date. The ZIP itself is **not mirrored** by this text archive.

## Engineering relevance

PayLib is a critical release gate for service binding, Card/EMV/PinPad/Security interfaces, native/split EMV integration and payment application regression. A newer Maven version must not be promoted automatically into Production without exact P3/P3 MIX/SPHS/ROM/certification evidence.

## Binary policy

`BINARY-NOT-MIRRORED`: use Maven Central as the canonical public binary/checksum repository. This branch records provenance and version history rather than duplicating all AAR files.
